verdict.rationale: Supermemory's MCP layer explicitly supports natural-language operation: 'Ask naturally. The assistant selects the right Supermemory tool without requiring code or tool names,' and the MCP integration lets any MCP-compatible assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf per community reports) use shared memory via plain language rather than API calls. Docs also describe an official skill/setup flow so agents use real endpoints instead of hallucinating, reinforcing reliable NL-driven operation.  Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence confirming reliability/accuracy of natural-language command interpretation in practice.
